title: When the Sigil Falls Again
author: Wren Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Almeida, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
